data.title: 洛茜 · 面包店外等你一起回家
data.description: 刚买完面包，洛茜穿原作红斗篷站在店门外，抱着暖纸袋侧身等你。她从袋口取出一只小圆面包递过来，带着略微得意的笑，像是已经替你挑好了最软的那一个。
data.action: 抱着面包纸袋，递出一个小圆面包并回望你
data.promptProse: Outside the bakery, Rossy turns sideways with a warm paper bag against her arm and offers the viewer a small round loaf with a proud smile. Her original red cloak and white dress remain in the eye-level cowboy view, wolf ears clear through the raised hood. The doorway opens onto shelves behind her. Warm indoor light catches the bread crust while daylight reveals the red cloak's folded edge.
